items.title: Randy Weston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Rahman? [INTERVIEWEE] Rachman, and she arranged for us...

ctx.x: Well, that was organized by a woman from India, Zeba…

Rachman, and she arranged for us… they were having a meeting of spiritual leaders from all over the world and the Arch Bishop of Canterbury in England. So she arranged for myself, and three Gnawa from Tangiers and leaders from everywhere. So it was my first experience to be in Canterbury. And when you go down in the basement you see all the bishops of England, you see all the various…it’s an amazing place, you know? We had to play for them. But it was an interesting experience because the hajhouj, or the ginbiri…
